intended_use.role: Independent validation reference only; not the production cooling implementation.
intended_use.rate_choice: cen must be supplied explicitly; upstream default is enzo.
intended_use.composition_note: The archived total_cooling entry point has no Y parameter; component defaults fix Y=0.24.
intended_use.return_quantity: Positive volumetric radiative cooling loss in erg cm^-3 s^-1.
intended_use.coefficient_normalization: Divide total_cooling by nH**2 to obtain Lambda_H in erg cm^3 s^-1.

scope_warnings: This is the official analytic primordial-equilibrium utility, not a run of the full Grackle chemistry/cooling solver or a Cloudy table.
Use only as a validation reference for an optically thin, low-density, atomic H/He, electron-collision ionization-equilibrium subset with fixed Y=0.24.
It contains no metals, molecular chemistry, external UV photoheating/photoionization, or CMB Compton cooling.
It is not identical to the current Grackle C core: neutral-collider ionization k57/k58 and some electron-density-squared helium cooling terms are absent; rate fits can also differ.
Selecting rates="cen" is an explicit reference-model choice, not a claim to reproduce the current Grackle default rates.
A collisional-ionization-equilibrium closure does not establish that a time-dependent gas equilibrates faster than it cools or evolves dynamically.
The source was archived and byte-checked only; it was not imported or executed during this provenance task.
